name: Max
subtitle: every Max's planet
beats: Everything on Max is set to maximum. The rivers, the sun, the birds.
The quiet setting was removed by public vote. The vote was very loud.
odd_line: The library is the loudest building on the planet. It had to compete.
story: Everything on Max is set to maximum. The rivers run at full volume, the sun is on its brightest setting, and the birds know one song, which is loud. There used to be a quiet setting. It was removed by public vote, and the vote was also very loud. The library is now the noisiest building on the planet, because it had to compete.
question: Know a Max? Is this accurate?
extra: Bedtime is set to maximum too. It hasn't been reached yet.

episode.opener:
Nothing here has
a quiet setting.

beats.text:
There used to be one.
It was removed by public vote.

Even the library is loud.
It had to compete.

Whispering requires a licence.
You apply by shouting.

Only one was ever issued,
to Nell, aged seven.
I've seen it. It's laminated.

Seventy-nine years later,
Nell used it.

episode.end: There's going to be a vote.
episode.caption:
Someone between the megaphones isn't shouting.

The sun is on its brightest setting, and so are the birds. The rivers run at full volume. Bedtime is set to maximum too, and nobody has reached it yet.

Nell got the planet's only whispering licence at seven, because she was the only child on Max who had never been told to keep it down. She grew up to be the librarian and kept it in a drawer at the issue desk, unspent, for seventy-nine years. The quiet didn't last. The shushing has.

I applied for a licence while I was there. Turned down: nobody heard me apply.

What would you spend one whisper on?
